packageRules.description: Only the community catalog's checks are followed here; other dependencies are updated by hand.
A pull request for each new commit of the community catalog (docs/architecture.md 4.9): CI checks the agent against it, a maintainer merges it, the next release ships it.
prBodyNotes: Read the catalog's `docs/format.md` for what changed: a new permission or field needs support in zendiloOS before the update is merged.
